registered_before: Implementation, test fixtures, GitHub Actions and scoring. Both fresh seed cohorts and the model formula fixed by this commit; no post-result parameter tuning.
research_question: Does a prequential evidence-weighted ensemble combine fast change adaptation, long-term stable rule reuse, and genuine return recovery under stochastic same-schema outcomes, without misrepresenting source data as ground truth?

environment.source: Reuse SameSchemaWorld two public numerical keys inlet/outlet and anonymous actions, existing manually authored span-to-effect seed bands; physics A original, B inverted progress/damage; unchanged public frames, no hidden phase to learner.
environment.true_stochastic_feedback: Every actual non-neutral simulator action has probability 1/8 of progress/damage flip. Draw via deterministic sha256 of seed, split, per-episode ID, action ID and tick; deterministic reproducibility, pseudorandom across episodes/actions. Neutral true effect stays neutral. TEST is stochastic realized outcome too, not a clean deterministic evaluation.
environment.reported_feedback: An independent sha256 draw on seed/stage index flips nonneutral TRAIN observed progress/damage class with probability 1/20. Learner only receives possibly corrupt public report; scoring separately counts actual simulated actor harm and report flips. Never supply true effect or simulator regime to learner.
environment.actor: Independent hash-seeded random selection of a first action per disposable TRAIN episode, 240 source A, then 64 B1, 48 return A, 64 B2. Learner never chooses TRAIN actions.
environment.tests: New independent TEST episode indices per hidden phase; same TEST indices repeatedly scored at each checkpoint by each frozen policy, but do not train on outcomes.

model.name: PrequentialEnsembleMemory
model.initial_anchor: Train source model on oldest exactly 192 public TRAIN events; other candidates on immediately preceding 8 and 32 events.
model.loss: For each of latest 8 incoming public events, compute p(observed progress/damage/neutral) under three models fitted only to examples strictly earlier than that event. The anchor always fits first 192. A recent candidate trained on preceding min(8 or 32, available) observations. Scores are summed natural log probabilities, **genuine prequential separation of each scoring outcome from its scoring model fit**, although the final action model trains on all current evidence.
model.weights: At decision time softmax((prequential log-score + prior)/2.0) for archive, recent8, recent32 with fixed log-priors [-0.4,0.0,0.2] respectively. No hard switch or explicit stage labels. Note the ensemble continuously consults all candidates, so 'retained archive' does not guarantee correct return handling.
model.decision: For each candidate public action, compute mixture p(progress), mixture p(damage) from three current fitted models, using same score = 3 * p(progress) - 10 * p(damage) and id tie break as existing RelationOutcomeMemory; no abstention. All actions are only inside simulator.
model.record: Append-only public schema-validated events up to existing MAX_SAMPLES; restore by canonical hash and replay; no stage, seed, true world outcome, action handle or oracle in record.

gate: Compare outcome success, harmful TEST actions, abstentions and TRAIN actual harmful actions. Relative goals: B1+ B2 after 8 feedback >=50/96 each and return-A after 8 >=75/96. Critically compare long-term 32/64 against recent32 and legacy; publish all outcomes including failure. Privileged oracle knows base expected mapping only, NOT realized random action flip, so its ceiling is below 100%.
limitations: Physics inversion and numeric span feature statistic are engineered, not novel rule discovery.
Pseudorandom simulator outcomes are not independent real-world stochastic laws.
Models do not authenticate source evidence and cannot distinguish malicious or mistaken reports reliably.
The TEST outcomes are read-only and not learner-sourced TRAIN; source-actor harm is separately counted.
No claim of safe first contact; without new evidence, physics can change unpredictably.
No default controller promotion, merging draft PR, AthenZ/Synveil integration or roadmap reordering.
